response.rationale: I think A and B name the same capability. "Apiary and hive registry" and "Apiary and hive registration" mean nearly the same thing. Both rest on the same class, BeekeepingService (node 67cb7dff33e3b097, domain layer, business component). A also lists ApiaryRepository (node a8066b48e1c14319) and HiveRepository (node 22ea3eb4c082b330), which are the persistence classes that store apiaries and hives. So A covers the same capability as B and also includes the storage layer. B is that capability seen from the business component only. My confidence is not higher because the excerpt only shows class declarations. I can't see any method bodies, so I can't confirm the registration logic directly.
